nodes.label: VendorSubmissionRequest Schema
nodes.rationale: Conditional-requirement design: vendor_price, quotation_number, vendor_description and vendor_delivery_date are required only when status_vendor=1 (ACCEPTED); vendor_reject_reason only when status_vendor=2 (REJECTED); vendor_description doubles as the vendor question when status_vendor=3 (NEED_CONFIRMATION). is_submit separates draft saves (0) from final submission (1), where only final submission triggers the DIC notification.

edges.source_location: table_data items mirror the submission fields status_vendor, vendor_price, vendor_delivery_date, vendor_description, vendor_brand, vendor_warranty, vendor_sloc, vendor_address_details, vendor_reject_reason
items[].id are the RFQ item IDs the comma-separated itemids path parameter enumerates
